scientific_integrity: Infinite statement justified by a written proof; finite 22-shift computer replay is illustration and not an infinite certificate. Standard Fibonacci rank/matrix facts and earlier boundedness/period results credited. Full independent mathematical audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to equal integer shifts |a| >= 2 and adjacent Fibonacci numbers. No general unequal-shift, higher-gap, excluded-shift, large-|a| asymptotic, or efficient-factorization conclusion. Some relevant source material was abstract-only, and unindexed equivalents remain possible.
title: Exact least periods and value densities of all bounded equally shifted Fibonacci gcd sequences
